forward (saves a, b, t, μ, σ, μ_o, σ_o, o, g)

W_p' = bf16(W_p * γ_o); s_p = W_p'.sum(1); e_p = W_p @ β_o
W_g' = bf16(W_g * γ); s_g = W_g'.sum(1); e_g = W_g @ β
W_p, W_g, γ_o, β_o, γ, β
o = σ_o * (t.T @ W_p'.T - μ_o * s_p) + e_p
g = σ * (x @ W_g'.T - μ * s_g) + e_g
HBM, forward (sizes at L = 768, D512 one direction)
dp = dy * ds * sigmoid(g); dg = dp * o * (1 - sigmoid(g))
dpr = dp * σ_o; S1 = dp·s_p; S2 = dp·(o - e_p)
dW_p = γ_o (dpr.T @ t.T - r1) + β_o r0
dt = γ_o do - σ_o (S1 + x̂ S2) / H
dpre = (d gate, d proj) from da, db
dx = dy + LN_backward(dx_n, x, μ, σ, γ)
